title: Establish the consumer contract before writing a failing regression
applies_when: A candidate alleges a formatting, validation, shape, resource-budget or backend-support mismatch from a helper name, comment or partial source window, and proposes expected behavior without tracing the producer and consumer.
lesson: Trace actual allocation/production, transformations and consumption before choosing expected behavior. DNS-SD instance labels allow punctuation that hostnames do not; applying hostname rules to every label can manufacture a failing test. Likewise, QSA speculative capture creates one metadata row per token, so replay's row count equals captured token capacity, not request count. A test that fabricates inconsistent internal metadata does not establish a reachable defect. Removing a device assertion or changing its error wording also does not establish backend support: require a documented supported caller and native kernel execution with checked outputs. Resource comments must be matched to actual registered geometry and implementation storage formulas: an excluded B_K=128 example does not justify removing registered B_K=64 kernels. Seek an observable consumer failure before repairing environments or publishing a correction. For nullable Arrow arrays, raw value-buffer iteration ignores validity. Trace an actual public query through serialization; vary the finite bytes underneath the same null slot, and retain all-valid and sliced-null-outside controls. Rejecting a required numeric coordinate's null is distinct from non-finite-number validation.
avoid_when: Do not dismiss reachable malformed host targets, escaping/length violations, or supported callers that mutate shapes or exceed allocation capacity. Error wording may itself be a documented API contract; validate that narrower claim separately rather than inferring backend support. A callback stand-in must preserve the real backend's layout transformations: RoPE+SDPA may take BSHD and return BHSD even when plain SDPA preserves shape. Baseline-fail/patch-pass against a shape-preserving invented callback is not a defect proof. Static review disproves only the specific alleged mismatch; it is not a native execution test or proof of general correctness.

evidence.note: Linear-attention CLI fields bind registered choices. The native argument builder forwards them to argparse; choices.py exposes plugin registration. Enum CUSTOM fallback alone therefore does not prove that a CLI typo passes validation. Programmatic consumers still need separate evidence; this is not a server or GPU qualification.

The real RoPE+FP8 SDPA backend explicitly takes BSHD and returns BHSD; its shared fake implementation permutes those dimensions. Plain SDPA's shape-preserving contract is different. This source contract refutes a proposed fake-kernel fix based on a callback that incorrectly preserves BSHD.

The upstream registered CPU fusion tests use a BHSD-returning RoPE callback matching the real backend's output geometry. Prefer these controls over an invented BSHD-returning stand-in; this public source is not a claim of FA3 GPU qualification.
DNS-SD instance labels permit non-control punctuation and are limited to 63 octets; this is a protocol requirement, not a measured application result.
The standard explicitly distinguishes service instance names from hostnames and their naming restrictions.

One normalizer feeds both a host label and a generated service instance. A trailing hyphen in the latter alone does not establish the claimed invalid zone. Explicit overrides and native resolver behavior require separate evidence.

Speculative capture sets metadata_rows=num_tokens and slices sequence_lengths to that capacity; replay retrieves the captured metadata and derives num_rows from sequence_lengths.numel(). This counters the claim that _stage_extend_lens receives request count instead of captured token capacity for a valid initialized capture. No GPU validation is implied.

The wrapper's device assertions precede a Triton kernel launch. A CPU/meta test that only checks rejection wording does not reach that launch or validate cache writes on another accelerator. This supports a test-scope caution, not a verdict that another backend is unsupported.

The comment excludes over-budget B_K=128 variants. Exact native registry lookup shows ids 1400-1404 and 6400-6404 instead use B_K=64. A regression asserting their removal manufactures the desired outcome rather than demonstrating the alleged comment contradiction.

Both mono_tile headers use padded two-slot A and three-slot B storage formulas. At the ten registered B_K=64 geometries, their declared buffers total 66-148.5 KiB, below the comment's 160 KiB threshold. The excluded B_K=128 examples total 165 and 231 KiB. This is source-derived arithmetic, not compiled HIP resource usage or GPU correctness.

The outer backend_requirement wrapper binds positional arguments with sig.bind and applies defaults before passing kwargs_with_defaults to the private problem-size checker. Reading only the helper's kwargs lookup manufactures a default/positional-argument defect. This does not qualify CUDA kernels or the separate skip_check/auto path.

The shown raw-verify constructor leaves extend_seq_lens at its default None. Its consumer handles None with full_like; the subsequent torch.minimum creates a new tensor before clamp_min_. Fabricating two non-None fields and asserting independent storage does not prove graph replay corruption on this path. Other supported setters still require separate inspection; Tensor.to alone does not guarantee a copy.

RadixLinearAttention.__init__ unconditionally assigns self.lower_bound from its optional argument. KDA packed decode's getattr guard followed by a direct attribute read therefore does not establish a missing-attribute defect for this shown constructor. Inspect the correct owning class, not the first same-named __init__ in a source file; fabricated objects without the attribute are not supported-path evidence. This is syntax-only source falsification, not GPU or all-model correctness.
Validity is separate from physical value storage; a zero null count may still have an explicit all-valid bitmap. This is a format contract, not application qualification.

Native remote-table/public-query regression: identical logical [0.1, null] with backing values 0 or 123 sends different numeric requests on unchanged main (four failures). The remote-only null guard passes 10 focused cases and 277 remote table tests, including all-valid and sliced controls. HTTP is mocked; live Cloud, rebuilt bindings, local-query semantics and performance are unqualified. Fork publication is not maintainer acceptance.
